Definition: from the base of G5567 (compare G5586); to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for:--feel after, handle, touch.
BiblicalUsage: Pselaphao means to handle, to feel after, to verify by touch. John says, That which we have heard, which we have seen with our eyes, which we have looked upon, and our hands have handled, of the Word of life, and the risen Jesus said, Behold My hands and My feet, that it is I Myself: handle Me, and see, for a spirit hath not flesh and bones, as ye see Me have. Paul says God made men that they should seek the Lord, if haply they might feel after Him, and find Him, and Hebrews says we are not come unto the mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the gospel is touchable: John handled the Word of life, the disciples handled the risen Lord, and I am invited to feel after God and find Him. I hold that the old mountain could be touched and it burned, but the new covenant is touched in a Man who welcomes the touch.
